en: The image is a vintage, sepia-toned postcard depicting a large Romanesque cathedral with two prominent towers, each featuring a bell. There is a clock on the right tower. In front of the cathedral, a few people are seen walking in an open square. The text at the bottom identifies the building as 'A Sé (La Cathédrale)' in Lisbon (Lisboa), and there is additional publication information in French and Portuguese.
